svg.title: Frontend engineering, with the product in mind.
svg.desc: I'm a Full-Stack AI engineer & Team Lead at Miznex, building web applications with React, Next.js, and TypeScript. I care about clear interactions, maintainable components, and reliable API integration. My work spans restaurant operations, interactive commerce, and business dashboards. I'm now expanding into Python, FastAPI, LLM API integration, and cloud fundamentals.
